newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER SHOWCASE-PORTO'S ARTUR IN DOUBT FOR BENFICA CLASH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-PORTO'S ARTUR IN DOUBT FOR BENFICA CLASH.

text.p: Porto's Brazilian striker Artur Oliveira is in doubt for Saturday's top of the table clash with Benfica after being injured in his side's 3-1 defeat of Guimaraes last weekend.
He felt pain in his right leg during training on Wednesday although club doctor Jose Carlos Esteves later told journalists the player could still be fit to face Benfica in Lisbon's Stadium of Light.
If the Brazilian fails to recover, then coach Antonio Oliveira could risk Domingos Oliveira who has yet to start a game since suffering a serious leg injury three months ago.
Domingos Oliveira, top scorer in the Portuguese league last season, has come on as substitute in Porto's last two matches.
Porto, going for a record third successive championship, lead the Portuguese league by five points from Benfica in second place.
